analysis: Examined: (1) docs/reference/protocol-messages.md head 1147-1155. The GLM contract now accepts null reasoning members and no-op reasoning.summary values. `strict` tools, response_format json_object/json_schema and forced tool_choice change from refusals to structured post-validation. Per the doc, content or calls are withheld until end of stream and validated; non-conforming output becomes 422 tool_noncompliance with nothing exposed. Reasoning still streams on a separate channel. tool_choice is advertised under tool-constraint protocol v1. No new WebSocket field or trust grant is added. The doc explicitly says this is not constrained decoding (T-007/T-056 posture unchanged). I could not verify the cited Swift sources (GLM5NextResponseFormat, ToolChoiceEnforcementPolicy, NativeToolStreamRouter, EngineV2RequestUsageSignal) in this batch. Integration should confirm that withheld content never streams before validation and that 422 failures do not leak partial content or bill inconsistently. (2) fixtures/prompt-contract/glm53-flash/README.md head 45-48 is a matching doc update with scoped claims; the vectors do not qualify these modes. (3) libs/mlx-swift-lm submodule bump 7bed8216 -> 6148b6da. The source is not supplied, so its effect on the TB-007 inference engine (in-process plaintext, KV cache, T-028/T-041 paths) is unreviewed. This is a coverage limit, not evidence of safety. (4) New provider-swift/.../Diagnostics/GLM5NextWiredLimit.swift lines 1-184 is advisory only and reads sysctls through sysctlbyname. It emits copy-paste sudo sysctl/LaunchDaemon text with fixed static values for M5 machines with 256 GiB. It contains no request data and its notice has no model input. It does not execute privileged actions itself and does not cross TB-010. Callers and doctor/log usage are not shown; integration should confirm that the notice is not derived from untrusted error text beyond pattern matching (isMetalOutOfMemory only matches strings). No regression identified.
